# Dr. Rizwin Aligner Orthodontist: advanced orthodontics and aligner treatment in Thrissur
> Dr. Rizwin is an orthodontist and clear aligner specialist in Thrissur, Kerala, India (MDS Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopaedics, Yenepoya University). He plans every aligner case himself, runs an in-house aligner unit, is a certified Invisalign, ClearCorrect and Spark provider, and educates dentists through The Aligner Project (Instagram: @thealignerproject). The practice offers clear aligners (planned personally and made in an in-house aligner unit), metal, self-ligating and lingual braces (including Brava), child orthodontics, retainers and second opinions. Online consultations are available for patients across India and abroad. Patients also travel from Kozhikode, Malappuram, Shoranur, Vatakara and Kannur. Clinic address: AVM Mall, Civil Lane Road, Sakthan, Laloor, Thrissur, Kerala 680003. Information on the site is educational and is not a diagnosis.
